content:
Successful calculation of weighted hospital bedflow metrics was achieved by forcing formula evaluation via headless LibreOffice and using robust INDEX-MATCH lookups.
The verifier required cached values from openpyxl's data_only mode, which were generated by running 'libreoffice --headless --convert-to xlsx' after writing formulas. Robust data retrieval was implemented using INDEX and MATCH functions to link series codes and years across the 'Data' sheet. Weighted means were calculated using the SUMPRODUCT and SUM pattern, while standard functions like MEDIAN and PERCENTILE ensured compatibility across calculation engines.
